thread:
Mia Chen: Quick heads-up — we need a compact QBR for Crestline next Wed. Focus: onboarding friction, renewal-risk mitigation, exec asks. Can we line up slide owners + a 15-min dry run?

Omar Patel: I can take renewal-risk slide. Can we include the last 30-day usage trend? @Jen can you add onboarding metrics?

Jen Park: Yep. I'll pull DAU, time-to-first-response, and onboarding dropoff by step. Noticed a big drop after the API key rotation — will call that out.

Sara Gomez: I'll own the action tracker and the enablement-requests slide. Can someone paste the open enablement asks?

CS-bot: Deck created from template: https://drive.redwood.company/qbr-templates/crestline — also added action tracker sheet (read/edit).

Mia Chen: Proposed owners (quick):
```
onboarding: Jen Park
renewal-risks: Omar Patel
exec-summary: Mia Chen
action-tracker: Sara Gomez
```
Can everyone confirm owners + add a 48h deliverable deadline on your slide? Also need a one-liner exec ask for privacy/legal review if we surface data residency concerns.

Omar Patel: Confirmed. I'll add the risk mitigation timeline + cost-vs-value bullets. 48h works.

Jen Park: Confirmed. Will add funnel chart + root-cause note on api-rotation. I'll paste the two interview quotes in the notes.

Sara Gomez: Confirmed. I'll seed the tracker with enablement asks, owners, and target dates. Will ping PSG for collateral.

Mia Chen: Small ask — put a 1-sentence 'ask from execs' in the header of your slide. We'll consolidate into a single asks slide.

Omar Patel: Flagging a renewal risk: EMEA usage down ~14% last 30 days. Recommending targeted enablement + a packaging/discount conversation. Adding details to slide.

Jen Park: Quick note — hitting rate-limit pulling step-level funnel in prod run. I'll run the export job and attach CSV in the tracker sheet.

Sara Gomez: Scheduling a 15-min dry run Fri 10:30 PT. Calendar invite incoming.

Mia Chen: Perfect — last thing: capture feedback snippets from two onboarding interviews in the deck notes. @Jen please paste the quotes so we can call them out in exec readout.

Jen Park: Will do and link the exported CSV in the action tracker.

Mia Chen: :thumbsup:
